title: Remove one practice node carefully
summary: A connected node cannot be deleted normally while its relationships remain.
introduction: A connected node cannot be deleted normally while its relationships remain. Your task: Run the MATCH as a RETURN first to inspect its target.
learningObjectives: Run the MATCH as a RETURN first to inspect its target.
Explain the example for remove one practice node carefully

blocks.text: A connected node cannot be deleted normally while its relationships remain. DETACH DELETE removes that node and its attached relationships.
Use Neo4j 5+ locally with Neo4j Browser or another Cypher editor. These queries use fictional cma-prefixed ids. Cypher is not SQL and does not run in this site's SQL playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `DETACH DELETE` removes matched nodes and their attached relationships. Inspect the match before running it.
`MATCH` finds the described graph pattern. Labels and arrow direction narrow the connections being followed.

blocks.text: Only the sample reader cma-r2 and its own connections are removed.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check the match before deleting. DETACH DELETE can remove important links if the pattern is too broad.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Run the MATCH as a RETURN first to inspect its target.
